admin.documents.body.description: Label of the text area of a document.

admin.documents.body.description.defaultMessage: Write in Markdown: headings (#), lists (-), links ([text](URL)) and emphasis (**bold**). Each line break starts a new line. Write it once, in any language: everyone reads the same text, whatever the language of their app. Save it empty to remove the text.
admin.documents.body.description.description: Description of the text area of a document: the Markdown it takes, that one text serves every language, and how to remove the text.

admin.documents.characters_left.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# character left} other {# characters left}}
admin.documents.characters_left.description: Character count under the text area of a document.

admin.documents.characters_over.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# character too many} other {# characters too many}}
admin.documents.characters_over.description: Character count under the text area of a document when the text is too long.

admin.documents.confirm_remove.cancel.description: Button of the dialog that keeps a document in a language.

admin.documents.confirm_remove.confirm.description: Button of the dialog that removes a document in a language.

admin.documents.confirm_remove.descripti.defaultMessage: The page and its links are hidden until the text is written again.
admin.documents.confirm_remove.descripti.description: Description of the question before removing a document's text.

admin.documents.confirm_remove.privacy_p.description: Title of the question before removing the privacy policy.

admin.documents.confirm_remove.terms.description: Title of the question before removing the terms of service.

admin.documents.privacy_policy.description: Heading of the section of the privacy policy on the terms and policies screen.

admin.documents.removed.defaultMessage: The text is removed. The audit log records the change.
admin.documents.removed.description: Status after a document's text was removed.

admin.documents.save.description: Button that saves the text of a document in the selected language.

admin.documents.save_failed.description: Error under a document's form when saving failed.

admin.documents.saved.defaultMessage: The text is saved. The audit log records the change.
admin.documents.saved.description: Status after a document's text was saved.

admin.documents.saved_at.description: Term of when the text of a document was last saved, on the terms and policies screen.

admin.documents.saved_at.never.defaultMessage: Not written yet, so the page and its links are hidden
admin.documents.saved_at.never.description: Value of the last save of a document that has no text.

admin.documents.summary.defaultMessage: The terms of service and the privacy policy that anyone can read and that people agree to when they sign up.
admin.documents.summary.description: Description of the terms and policies screen in the admin menu.

admin.documents.terms.description: Heading of the section of the terms of service on the terms and policies screen.

admin.documents.title.description: Title and heading of the admin screen where administrators write the terms of service and the privacy policy, and its link in the admin menu.

admin.documents.too_long.description: Error of the text area of a document when the text is too long.

admin.documents.unsaved.description.defaultMessage: Your changes to this text will be lost.
admin.documents.unsaved.description.description: Body of the dialog that asks before leaving the terms and policies screen with unsaved texts.

admin.documents.unsaved.leave.description: Button that leaves the terms and policies screen, losing the unsaved texts.

admin.documents.unsaved.stay.description: Button that stays on the terms and policies screen with the unsaved texts.

admin.documents.unsaved.title.description: Title of the dialog that asks before leaving the terms and policies screen with unsaved texts.

admin.documents.view_privacy_policy.description: Link from the terms and policies screen to the public page of the privacy policy.

admin.documents.commerce_disclosure.description: Heading of the section of the terms and policies screen where administrators write the commerce disclosures of the supporter plans (ADR-0072 §13).

admin.documents.commerce_disclosure.desc.defaultMessage: What the law of your country asks a seller to disclose, such as the 特定商取引法に基づく表記 in Japan. It is published at /about/commerce, and the supporter screens link to it. The server does not check or guarantee that it meets the law: check what the law asks yourself.
admin.documents.commerce_disclosure.desc.description: Description of the commerce disclosures on the terms and policies screen: what they are, where they are published, and that the software does not guarantee their legal correctness.

admin.documents.view_commerce_disclosure.description: Link from the terms and policies screen to the public page of the commerce disclosures.

admin.documents.confirm_remove.commerce_.description: Title of the confirmation before saving the commerce disclosures empty, which removes them.

admin.documents.view_terms.defaultMessage: Open the terms of service page
admin.documents.view_terms.description: Link from the terms and policies screen to the public page of the terms of service.

admin.documents.pages.description: Name of the navigation of the pages of the terms and policies screen, one per document, under its heading.
